purpose: Defines the visual and functional spaces before the 1933 office hub. Spectacular command rooms are deliberately withheld until later progression.

global_stages.label: Geburt / Elternhaus
global_stages.visual_rule: No office imagery. Family home and period-appropriate surroundings only.

global_stages.label: Kindheit / Lernen
global_stages.visual_rule: A modest desk, books or school materials may appear; no political command elements.

global_stages.label: Erster Beruf / Dienst
global_stages.visual_rule: First real office functions, but usually shared or limited.

global_stages.label: Eigenes Arbeitszimmer
global_stages.visual_rule: First room that visually belongs to the avatar.

global_stages.label: Politisches / leitendes Büro
global_stages.visual_rule: Power becomes visible but state authority is not implied unless historically held.

global_stages.label: Regierungs-/Übergangsbüro
global_stages.visual_rule: Only unlocked by actual office/institutional authority.

global_stages.label: Steuerzentrale 1933
global_stages.visual_rule: Uses office_hubs.json and each avatar's historically appropriate 1 January 1933 level.

late_highlights.rule: Do not show these as fully realized spaces in the prologue or low-power offices. Tease locked doors, plans, empty room labels or upgrade silhouettes only when appropriate.

highlights.payoff: Large interactive strategic wall map and resource/logistics overlays.
Multiple telephone lines, telegraph/teleprinter and secure communications.
Fronts, supply, mobilization and production become a dedicated command space.
Dedicated intelligence picture, networks and counterintelligence.
Cabinet crises, multi-party diplomacy and major delegations.
The strongest visual culmination: global logistics, multi-front view, alliance coordination and strategic reserves.

continuity_rules: Items gained in a prior space can appear later if still owned.
Contacts unlocked during education or career can populate later telephone lists.
Health and injuries persist across all spaces.
Personal wealth and state treasury remain separate throughout progression.
A room upgrade never grants political authority by itself.
Late highlight rooms are gameplay rewards and status feedback, not cosmetic shortcuts.
